text_block_list.text:
The first target race of the Classic year, 
the Elfin Stakes held at Kyoto Racecourse. 
The morning of race day has finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san! 
Look, it's a replica sword!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It feels... so very Kyoto. 
Ooh...
choice_data_list: Want me to take a picture?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to send it to my mother and 
everyone back home...

During her Make Debut, Daring Tact was 
full of nerves... 
but this time around, she even has room to 
enjoy the sights of Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... it feels like the 
racecourse is much livelier than it was 
for my Make Debut.
choice_data_list:
People probably have their eyes on the 
Classic races.

Everyone's likely looking ahead toward the 
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense. 
A standout star could very well emerge 
from this race...
choice_data_list: And that star is without a doubt you!
And that's definitely going to be you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... yes! 
I'll do my very best to make sure it is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Right now, there are still plenty of 
people 
who don't know who I am... and that's only 
natural.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to show everyone. 
The potential that you, Tore-san, 
have nurtured so patiently and tenderly 
within me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's blow them all away!
Yeah, let's show the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
—I'm going to bring home the win!
